title: Crash when selecting "Unwrap UV2 for Lightmap/AO" after undo
body:
### Tested versions

- v4.5.1.stable.official [f62fdbde1]
- v4.6.beta.custom_build [20b67f366]


### System information

Godot v4.6.beta (20b67f366) - Debian GNU/Linux 13 (trixie) 13 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated Intel(R) UHD Graphics 630 (CFL GT2) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-8850H CPU @ 2.60GHz (12 threads) - 31.11 GiB memory

### Issue description

Using "Unwrap UV2 for Lightmap/AO" a second time after undoing crashes Godot.

### Steps to reproduce

I noticed this with several custom meshes (MeshInstance3D), but these steps don't require external data:

- Create a 3D scene
- Add a CSGBox3D
- From the CSG menu, select "Bake Mesh Instance"
- Select the created CSGBakedMeshInstance3D
- From the CSG menu, select "Unwrap UV2 for Lightmap/AO"
- Press CTRL + Z (undo)
- From the CSG menu, select "Unwrap UV2 for Lightmap/AO" again
